title: CSV export and import of assets
interface:
final class AssetCsv. Constructor: __construct(\Drupal\Core\Entity\EntityTypeManagerInterface $entityTypeManager, \Drupal\Core\Config\ConfigFactoryInterface $configFactory, \Drupal\hwdesk\Service\TagGenerator $tagGenerator). Service 'hwdesk.asset_csv' (registered). public const COLUMNS = ['tag','type','manufacturer','model','serial_number','status','condition','holder','location','tags','invoice','price','warranty_until','cost_center','notes'].
export(iterable $assets): string -- UTF-8 BOM "\xEF\xBB\xBF", then header (COLUMNS joined by ';'), then one line per Asset, lines end with "
"; delimiter ';'; a field is wrapped in double quotes (inner quotes doubled) only when it contains ';', '"', "
" or "". Values: tag; type key; manufacturer; model; serial_number; status value; condition value; holder = holder's e-mail or ''; location = location name or ''; tags = tag names joined by '|' in stored order; invoice = invoice number or ''; price = '' when NULL, else number_format((float) $value, 2, '.', '') (the database may hand the decimal back as a float); warranty_until = 'Y-m-d' or ''; cost_center; notes. Iterate in the given order.
import(string $csv): array -- ['created' => int, 'updated' => int, 'errors' => list<string>]. Strip a leading BOM; split lines on 
 or 
; ignore empty lines; parse with str_getcsv($line, ';', '"', '\'); the header must equal COLUMNS exactly (after trimming cells) else \InvalidArgumentException. Rows are numbered from 1 = header, so the first data row is 'řádek 2'. Per data row: trim cells; a row is applied only when it is fully valid, otherwise one error string 'řádek <n>: <reason>' naming the bad value is added and the row is skipped. Validation: type must be a key of config hwdesk.settings 'asset_types' (error names the type); model non-empty (error contains 'model'); status must be a \Drupal\hwdesk\AssetStatus value (error names the value; empty = 'in_stock'); condition must be a \Drupal\hwdesk\AssetCondition value (empty = 'new'); holder: empty = NULL, else a user with that e-mail (case-insensitive; load users by 'mail' with a case-insensitive entity query) must exist (error names the e-mail); invoice: empty = NULL, else an hwdesk_invoice with that number must exist (error names the number); location: empty = NULL, else find hwdesk_location by name or create it; tags: split on '|', trim, drop blanks, find hwdesk_tag by name or create it; price: '' = NULL else the string as given; warranty_until: '' = NULL else 'Y-m-d'. Upsert: tag non-empty -> load hwdesk_asset by tag (upper-cased); found -> update all columns and count 'updated'; not found -> create with that tag (call $tagGenerator->reserve($tag)) and count 'created'; tag empty -> create with $tagGenerator->next($type). Save each applied row; do not stop on errors.
File header: <?php + declare(strict_types=1); namespace Drupal\hwdesk\Service; final class; constructor property promotion with readonly; no \Drupal:: static calls (everything is injected); no other new files.
database: entity storage through the injected EntityTypeManagerInterface
